description: Review taglines. Give `taglines` (1 to 25, one per line), optionally `brand` (to flag repeating the name) and `cliches` (extra phrases to flag). Checks word and character count, about 90 stock phrases and fillers, abstract words, three-item lists, 'where X meets Y' constructions, exclamation marks, and concreteness (numbers or named things). Returns a 0 to 100 concreteness score per line, issues, and a flag when the line could be used by any competitor. A heuristic aid; it does not check uniqueness or legal status.
name: tagline_review
title: Tagline review
